substantive_commits.summary: Add source-side AC guard round-wire refinement pass.
Harden the AC fan construction contract for round-wire geometry.
Harden round-wire topology, material binding, axial-clearance and LOD validation.
Bind round-wire refinement before Danchi LOD generation and into final Danchi validation.
Document the round-wire cross-section in the AC fan lookdev illustration.
Raise guard ring/cross-section tessellation contract for native-4K grazing response.
Implement 48-segment ring paths and 12-sided 5 mm round wire for reduced specular faceting.
Align lookdev documentation with the higher 4K guard tessellation.
Add a physical galvanized guard-to-shroud mounting-interface refinement.
Define physical guard mounting feet, seating and LOD policy in the construction contract.
Bind guard mounts before Danchi LOD proxy generation and directly validate them.
Separate round-wire and mount-interface contract revisions so both validators remain fail-closed and compatible.
Rename guard-mount objects to avoid collision with the existing HD_AC_FanGuard LOD-count prefix while retaining Feet-based LOD1 classification.
Update lookdev with four physical guard mounting feet and seating evidence targets.

problems_found: The existing construction contract and lookdev described the outdoor-condenser guard as round-section rings plus radial spokes, but the generated radial spokes were finite-thickness rectangular extrusions. At native-4K grazing angles this could produce flat-strip metallic highlights inconsistent with the claimed manufactured wire construction.

The guard was intentionally offset in front of the molded shroud, leaving about 5.5 mm of axial air gap, but no explicit mounting hardware bridged that gap. In close benchmark framing the guard could therefore read as unsupported/floating, which is a critical-defect risk rather than a cosmetic issue.

manufacture_installation_reasoning.scope: manufacturer-neutral late-1990s/circa-2000 Japanese balcony condenser benchmark reconstruction; not a specific maker/model claim
manufacture_installation_reasoning.rotor: five finite-thickness swept/tapered blades on the existing motor/hub axis; deterministic stopped clock-angle variation remains unchanged
manufacture_installation_reasoning.inlet_shroud: finite-depth molded annular intake lip remains the large circular long-distance form

wire_guard.construction: four concentric rings plus eight radial spokes, all with physical circular 5 mm wire section
wire_guard.geometry_vs_material: round curvature is geometry so the metallic grazing highlight is produced by surface orientation; no painted/baked highlight is introduced

guard_mount_interface.construction: four formed/welded galvanized circular feet/standoffs aligned to diagonal guard directions
guard_mount_interface.geometry_vs_material: axial bridge and physical seating are geometry; zinc/steel dulling and oxidation remain PBR/weathering response

materials.rotor_and_shroud: existing dark injection-molded dielectric polymer contract retained; metallic <= 0.02, dry benchmark
materials.guard_and_mounts: existing aged galvanized-steel material retained; metallic response comes from steel/zinc plus physical round curvature, not highlight painting

manufacture_installation_reasoning.weathering: guard and mounting feet inherit rain/sun exposure with FerrousFixture + UVExposure causality; no arbitrary rust/contact dirt is added solely to make the hardware visible

formal_build_and_lod.lod0: rotor + shroud + full round-wire guard + physical mounts
formal_build_and_lod.lod1: same canonical round-wire guard and mount meshes retained with cross-fade
formal_build_and_lod.lod2: guard and mounting feet removed before sub-pixel wire/hardware aliasing; rotor + shroud remain
formal_build_and_lod.lod3: shroud remains as intake silhouette; rotor/guard/mounts removed
formal_build_and_lod.mount_prefix_regression_fixed: Mount object is HD_AC_GuardMountFeet rather than an HD_AC_FanGuard* prefix so the existing physical fan validator still counts exactly 15 wire guards while Feet classification retains the mount through LOD1.

documents: 5 mm round wire with 48 ring segments and 12-sided wire section
four 15 mm-diameter physical galvanized guard feet
controlled shroud seating rather than a floating guard
dry dielectric/polymer and metallic galvanized response

implementation_readiness.reason: Construction fidelity and QA coverage improved, but the repository's remaining seven readiness points are explicitly reserved for Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime verification and native capture evidence, which are still unavailable.

expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Geometry & construction fidelity: major positive potential: radial guard elements now match the declared round-wire manufacture and the guard has an explicit load/support path into the shroud
expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Material/PBR physical plausibility: medium positive potential: galvanized highlights now derive from circular geometry and material response rather than a flat spoke strip; no painted highlight added
expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Lighting/shadows/reflections: small-to-medium positive potential: round wire and physical mounting feet create more plausible grazing specular/shadow/contact behavior, pending actual reflection/capture pixels
expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Texture/microdetail/texel fidelity: small positive potential: denser 48x12 guard tessellation reduces geometric faceting risk in the 4K service crop; this is not a texture-score claim
expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Weathering/context causality: small-to-medium positive potential: new exposed galvanized mounts carry explicit ferrous/UV/rain causality rather than arbitrary grime
expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Period accuracy/scene authenticity: small-to-medium positive potential: the balcony condenser reads more like an assembled manufactured unit rather than abstract guard geometry
expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Cinematic image quality/composition/colo: medium positive potential in oblique/grazing service highlights; unobservable until native render
expected_score_impact_not_awarded.Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: medium potential: guard and mount are explicitly retained together through LOD1 and removed before LOD2, but pop/shimmer can only be judged from motion pixels
